    assert c.get("a") == 1
    c.set("c", 3)
    assert c.get("b") is None
    assert list(c.items) == ["a", "c"]


def test_invalidate_prefix_removes_matching_string_keys_and_counts_them():
    c = LRUCache(5)
    c.set("api:1", 10)
    c.set("api:2", 20)
    c.set("user:1", 30)
    removed = c.invalidate_prefix("api:")
    assert removed == 2
    assert "api:1" not in c.items
    assert "api:2" not in c.items
    assert "user:1" in c.items


def test_invalidate_prefix_preserves_remaining_lru_order():
    c = LRUCache(6)
    c.set("old:a", 1)
    c.set("old:b", 2)
    c.set("new:a", 3)
    c.set("new:b", 4)
    c.get("old:a")
    c.get("new:b")
    c.invalidate_prefix("old:")
    assert list(c.items) == ["new:a", "new:b"]


def test_invalidate_prefix_leaves_non_string_keys_untouched():
    c = LRUCache(4)
    c.set("prefix:1", 1)
    c.set(1, 100)

    removed = c.invalidate_prefix("prefix")
    assert removed == 1
    assert "prefix:1" not in c.items
    assert 1 in c.items
